one_liner: PitchBook has a REST API (PB-Token API key) for private market data, but access is a paid, contract-gated Direct Data add-on with no self-serve signup; an official OAuth MCP also exists.
auth_notes: Static key sent as 'Authorization: PB-Token {API_KEY}'. Keys are provisioned by account manager; API credits also required. The MCP server uses OAuth but is a separate enterprise-licensed connector, not the public REST API.
access_notes: API is an enterprise add-on requiring a separate contract with the Direct Data team on top of a platform subscription, plus purchased credits. Sandbox key only via account manager.
blocker_notes: No self-serve credentials; need a contract and API credits via PitchBook's Direct Data team/account manager.

evidence.quote: include a header named "Authorization" with the value of "PB-Token {API_KEY}" with each API request.
Access to the PitchBook API is a paid, contract-gated add-on and is not available via a self-serve dashboard.
API access is a paid, contract-gated add-on with no free tier
The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser.
PitchBook uses OAuth: the first time you connect, your MCP client opens a browser window to sign in and authorize access
PitchBook Data MCP gives investment teams native, secure access to a subset of PitchBook’s dataset, including company, deal, investor, and fund data
